name: Rehoboam
overview: Rehoboam, Solomon's son, ascended to the throne following his father's death, as recorded in 1 Kings 11:43 and 12:1. When the people of Israel, led by Jeroboam who had fled to Egypt, requested that Rehoboam lighten the heavy burdens imposed by Solomon, Rehoboam asked for three days before responding (1 Kings 12:2-5). This moment marks the beginning of his reign and sets the stage for the challenges he would face, including the eventual revolt of the ten tribes under Jeroboam's leadership.
